public_rationale: The strongest independent evaluation examined shows substantial progress, but it does not establish AGI or an LLM-only counterexample. It also cannot prove that future LLMs will never qualify. No decisive event meeting the resolution rule was established by October 28, 2026.
limitations: The review cannot establish the absence of every possible demonstration.
AGI and LLM-only system boundaries remain ambiguous.
The present-tense premise is not separately scored as a second claim.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: LLMs on their own are not and will never be AGI.

statement.excerpt: LLMs are not AGI, and (on their own) never will be; scaling alone was never going to be enough.
statement.document_title: August 5, 2024, a big day in tech?

our_interpretation: Assess the enduring prediction, including its present-tense premise; no deadline is supplied.
Read AGI as broadly human-level ability to learn, reason and apply knowledge across unfamiliar intellectual tasks.
Read 'on their own' as requiring the LLM itself to supply the relevant intelligence, without external solvers, retrieval systems or human assistance supplying essential capabilities.
Ordinary input/output and model execution do not by themselves disqualify a system.
'On their own' restricts which systems count as counterexamples; it is not an antecedent requiring a separate future event.
criteria.support_condition: A conclusive, independently scrutinized general result establishes that LLMs alone cannot reach the specified breadth of intelligence. Failures of existing models cannot establish 'never'.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented LLM alone demonstrates broadly human-level general intelligence under independent evaluation, with sufficient system disclosure to verify the scope restriction.

evidence.excerpt: Therefore, while we believe Astra represents meaningful progress towards generalization, we are not claiming that it is AGI.
evidence.explanation: The evaluation reports 62.7% with the standard harness and 99.9% with a provider adapter, plus strong action efficiency relative to humans. These are material advances, but the evaluators expressly decline to equate them with AGI; they do not settle the LLM-only prediction.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: An independently replicated demonstration of broadly human-level general intelligence supplied by an LLM alone, with adequate system disclosure, would contradict the forecast. A conclusive general impossibility result could support it.
